SELECT 
NULL AS Account_Number
,NULL AS Card_Relationship_Indicator
,DC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME AS Customer_Local_Name
,DC.CUST_NBR AS Customer_Number
,NULL AS Card_Number
,NULL AS Valid_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Block_Code
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code
,NULL AS General_Status
,NULL AS Product_Code
,NULL AS Product_Type
,NULL AS Product_Type2
,NULL AS Product_Variant
,NULL AS Card_Format_ID
,NULL AS Virtual_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS Card_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS With_Replacement_Tag
,NULL AS Converted_Tag
,NULL AS Open_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN
            CHARINDEX('TEST0', DC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            CHARINDEX('TEST ', DC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            CHARINDEX('TESTC', DC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            substr(CCEC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,1,3) in ('TES', 'TST', 'XXX') 
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS Test_Card_Tag
,NULL AS ECP_Tag
,NULL AS ECC_Tag
,NULL AS VIP_Tag
,NULL AS Secured_Tag
,NULL AS Depositor_Tag
,DC.CUST_CIF_NBR AS CIF_Number
,NULL AS Auto_Debit_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN DC.CUST_RELATION IN (1, 2) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS DOSRI_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN DC.CUST_RELATION IN (5, 6) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS RPT_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Last_Renewal_Date
,NULL AS Card_Expiry
,NULL AS Account_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Activation_Date_Updated
,NULL AS Source_Code
,NULL AS Account_Credit_Limit
,NULL AS [Count]
,NULL AS [Sequence]
,NULL AS [Set]
,NULL AS Orig_Cardholder_Type
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER DC
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP CCEC ON DC.CUST_NBR = CCEC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
WHERE DC.ISLATEST = 1

UNION ALL
SELECT 
NULL AS Account_Number
,NULL AS Card_Relationship_Indicator
,MC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME AS Customer_Local_Name
,MC.CUST_NBR AS Customer_Number
,NULL AS Card_Number
,NULL AS Valid_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Block_Code
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code
,NULL AS General_Status
,NULL AS Product_Code
,NULL AS Product_Type
,NULL AS Product_Type2
,NULL AS Product_Variant
,NULL AS Card_Format_ID
,NULL AS Virtual_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS Card_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS With_Replacement_Tag
,NULL AS Converted_Tag
,NULL AS Open_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN
            CHARINDEX('TEST0', MC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            CHARINDEX('TEST ', MC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            CHARINDEX('TESTC', MC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            substr(CCECP.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE,1,3) in ('TES', 'TST', 'XXX') 
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0U
    END AS Test_Card_Tag
,NULL AS ECP_Tag
,NULL AS ECC_Tag
,NULL AS VIP_Tag
,NULL AS Secured_Tag
,NULL AS Depositor_Tag
,MC.CUST_CIF_NBR AS CIF_Number
,NULL AS Auto_Debit_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN MC.CUST_RELATION IN (1, 2) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS DOSRI_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN MC.CUST_RELATION IN (5, 6) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS RPT_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Last_Renewal_Date
,NULL AS Card_Expiry
,NULL AS Account_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Activation_Date_Updated
,NULL AS Source_Code
,NULL AS Account_Credit_Limit
,NULL AS [Count]
,NULL AS [Sequence]
,NULL AS [Set]
,NULL AS Orig_Cardholder_Type
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER MC
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACP CCECP ON MC.CUST_NBR = CCECP.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
WHERE MC.ISLATEST = 1
